meta.intensity_reason: France PA mandate under 4 months · 101 PAs certified · Penalty regime tripled (€50/invoice, €15k cap) · Cegid 100-rep blitz live
meta.ifyrne: France's September 1, 2026, PA mandate looms large, with 101 accredited platforms already available, demanding Sage ensure Sage Active and AutoEntry+AKAO are either accredited or integrated. Germany's XRechnung mandate by January 2028 presents a critical compliance driver for all businesses, while Pennylane's €175M funding and aggressive European expansion, especially into Spain before Sage Active's launch, pose a significant competitive threat. Cegid's recent addition of 100 sales reps targeting German practices further intensifies the competitive landscape. Sage must prioritize securing PA accreditation for its French solutions and accelerate its Spanish market entry strategy to counter Pennylane's advance.
meta.last_scan_summary: Refresh complete - data current as of 11 May 2026

summaries.DE: The German market shows significant activity in cloud migration (DATEV), regulatory e-invoicing mandates (XRechnung), and competitive consolidation (Cegid/sevDesk).
summaries.Pennylane: Pennylane is aggressively expanding across Europe with significant funding, a strong focus on AI development, and strategic market entries, posing a substantial competitive threat to Sage.

signals.title: Pennylane to enhance AI tools for accountants
signals.body: With its recent funding, Pennylane plans to intensify R&D investments, focusing on building generative AI tools such as an analysis-assistant co-pilot for accountants. These tools aim to automate bookkeeping tasks and provide richer, proactive insights to clients.
signals.implication: Pennylane's focus on AI-driven tools for accountants directly challenges Sage's offerings in this area. Sage must accelerate its own AI development and integration to maintain parity and offer competitive advantages to its accounting partners.

signals.title: Pennylane launches in Germany, targeting 100 hires
signals.body: Pennylane has officially launched in Germany, marking its first overseas market expansion. The company plans to hire 100 staff in the country and has established its German headquarters in Munich. This move directly targets the complex German accounting market, where Pennylane will compete with established players like DATEV.
signals.implication: Pennylane's entry into Germany, a key market for Sage, intensifies competition. Sage needs to assess its German strategy and offerings to effectively counter Pennylane's localized approach and aggressive hiring plans.

signals.title: Pennylane secures €175M funding to accelerate AI and European expansion
signals.body: Pennylane raised €175 million in a Series E funding round led by TCV and Blackstone Growth, with participation from existing investors. This capital infusion is earmarked for accelerating AI capabilities and expanding its presence across Europe, positioning Pennylane for potential market consolidation. The company's valuation reached approximately $4.25 billion.
signals.implication: Pennylane's significant funding and aggressive expansion plans, particularly in AI, pose a direct threat to Sage's market share in Europe. This necessitates a swift and robust response from Sage to counter Pennylane's growing competitive advantage.

signals.title: Cegid acquires sevDesk, strengthening its presence in German SMB market.
signals.body: Cegid acquired sevDesk, a German provider of digital invoicing and accounting solutions for SMBs, in February 2025. This acquisition expands Cegid's offering in German-speaking Europe, a market with over 5 million SMBs and growing demand for cloud software and e-invoicing compliance. SevDesk serves over 130,000 customers.
signals.implication: Cegid's strengthened position in the German SMB market, particularly with sevDesk's existing customer base, increases competitive pressure. Sage needs to differentiate its offerings, potentially by emphasizing its specific accountant-focused solutions and broader European reach.
signals.source: sevdesk is now part of Cegid (February 06 2025)

signals.title: Verifactu deadlines confirmed for Jan 2027 (corporate) and Jul 2027 (self-employed).
signals.body: The final deadlines for Verifactu compliance in Spain have been confirmed: January 1, 2027, for companies subject to corporate income tax, and July 1, 2027, for all other businesses and self-employed individuals. This regulation aims to combat tax fraud through real-time invoice verification. Software providers are obligated to implement the system, while businesses can choose to voluntarily submit their invoices.
signals.implication: Sage Active and other Sage products must be fully Verifactu-compliant by these dates to avoid penalties and ensure market competitiveness. Proactive communication and enablement for Spanish customers are crucial.
signals.source: Wolters Kluwer, Holded, Datisa ERP, TeamSystem, REIXMOR (various dates in 2025-2026)

signals.title: Sage Active Promotes Electronic Invoicing Compliance for French Accountants
signals.body: Sage is actively marketing Sage Active as a solution compliant with the upcoming French electronic invoicing mandate, emphasizing its integration with 'Plateforme Agréée' (PA) and AI capabilities. This suggests Sage is preparing its offerings to meet the September 1, 2026 deadline.
signals.implication: While Sage is promoting compliance, the market signals indicate strong competition from players like Pennylane and the Cegid/EBP entity. Sage must ensure its messaging and product delivery effectively highlight its readiness and advantages to retain and attract French accounting firms.

signals.title: Pennylane Solidifies Position for 2026 Electronic Invoicing Mandate
signals.body: Pennylane is actively positioning itself as a key solution for the upcoming 2026 electronic invoicing mandate in France, emphasizing its platform's ability to handle compliance and streamline financial management for both businesses and accounting firms. Recent articles highlight its readiness and focus on this regulatory shift.
signals.implication: Pennylane's proactive stance on the 2026 mandate could capture significant market share among accountants and their clients, potentially drawing them away from Sage's offerings if Sage is perceived as less prepared.

signals.title: Qualified Electronic Signature (QES) Mandatory for PDF Invoices from Jan 2027
signals.body: From January 1, 2027, PDF invoices in Portugal, unless exchanged via Electronic Data Interchange (EDI), must include a Qualified Electronic Signature (QES) to be legally valid. Standard PDF invoices are accepted until December 31, 2026.
signals.implication: This regulatory change will require businesses to adopt new signing processes for their invoices. Sage needs to ensure its solutions support QES compliance for Portuguese customers by the 2027 deadline.

signals.title: Cegid Primavera Updates for 2026 Legal Requirements
signals.body: Cegid has updated its Primavera HR module for ERP v10, ERP Evolution, and ERP Public Sector to comply with 2026 legal requirements, including adjustments to the Guaranteed Minimum Monthly Remuneration (RMMG) and the Indexant of Social Support (IAS).
signals.implication: Cegid Primavera is actively adapting to local Portuguese regulations, indicating a strong commitment to the market. This reinforces their position as a key competitor, especially with their established presence and ongoing updates.

signals.title: SAF-T Accounting File Submission Postponed to Fiscal Year 2027
signals.body: The mandatory submission of the SAF-T Accounting file in Portugal has been postponed to fiscal year 2027, with the first submission due in 2028. This extension provides businesses additional time to ensure their accounting systems are compliant. However, the file remains mandatory for tax inspections upon request.
signals.implication: This delay offers a slight reprieve for compliance efforts but underscores the ongoing importance of SAF-T. Sage needs to monitor the finalization of these deadlines and ensure its solutions remain aligned.
signals.source: Comarch (Dec 09 2025), RTC Suite (Apr 29 2025), Invoice Data Extraction (Mar 07 2026)

signals.title: AI agents rapidly increasing efficiency in German tax advisory firms
signals.body: A recent report highlights that AI agents are significantly boosting efficiency in German tax advisory firms, with some saving up to 5 hours per week per advisor. The global market for AI in accounting is projected to grow substantially. Tax advisory firms are shifting from hourly billing to value-based pricing and expanding advisory services as AI handles routine tasks. This trend indicates a growing demand for AI-powered solutions within the German accounting sector.
signals.implication: Competitors and DATEV are likely integrating AI to enhance their offerings. Sage WiSE needs to assess its AI strategy for Germany, focusing on how AI can automate compliance and provide value-added services to accountants and their clients.

signals.title: Cegid-EBP merger aims to capture French SMB and accounting firm market.
signals.body: Cegid's acquisition of EBP is strategically designed to enhance its offering for French SMEs and accounting firms, complementing its existing product suite with EBP's invoicing, commercial management, and accounting solutions. This move strengthens Cegid's European leadership, particularly in the French market.
signals.implication: The combined strength of Cegid and EBP presents a significant competitive challenge in France, potentially impacting Sage's market share, especially if they leverage their expanded sales force effectively.

signals.title: DATEV announces full cloud migration for all software by 2026
signals.body: DATEV has announced that all its software will be migrated to the cloud by 2026, with locally installed solutions being phased out. This transition aims to improve efficiency and reduce workload for tax firms and their clients. The company is actively engaging with its partners to manage this shift, emphasizing that early adoption of cloud processes will yield faster benefits.
signals.implication: This signals a significant shift in the German accounting software market, potentially creating opportunities for Sage to offer complementary cloud solutions or integrations above DATEV's core offering. It also highlights the increasing importance of cloud-native solutions.

signals.title: Pennylane expands accountant partnerships in France
signals.body: Multiple French accounting firms, such as CECCA and Raly Conseils, are actively promoting their partnership with Pennylane, highlighting its all-in-one financial and accounting management platform. These firms emphasize the platform's ability to automate accounting, provide real-time financial insights, and ensure 100% compliance with e-invoicing regulations.
signals.implication: Pennylane is solidifying its position in the French market by leveraging strong partnerships with expert-comptables, directly competing with Sage's offerings for accountants.

signals.title: Germany clarifies e-invoicing mandate: Sending becomes mandatory Jan 2027 for larger businesses
signals.body: Germany's phased e-invoicing mandate now requires businesses with an annual turnover exceeding €800,000 to issue structured e-invoices starting January 1, 2027. Universal sending requirements are set for January 2028. All businesses must be capable of receiving e-invoices since January 1, 2025.
signals.implication: Accelerated need for businesses to comply with e-invoicing regulations, creating urgency for solutions that support XRechnung and ZUGFeRD formats. This impacts Sage Active's readiness for the German market.
signals.source: E-Invoicing in Germany 2026: Obligations, Timeline, Format and Examples, May 20, 2026

signals.title: Contasol (Software DELSOL) ready for Verifactu
signals.body: Contasol, a software from Software DELSOL, is highlighted as being prepared for Verifactu, offering features for electronic invoicing and compliance with fiscal obligations. They are actively marketing their solutions for SMEs, freelancers, and advisory services in Spain.
signals.implication: Contasol is positioning itself as a Verifactu-ready solution, particularly for the SME and autónomo segments. Sage needs to ensure Sage Active's Spanish offering is clearly communicated as compliant and competitive.

signals.title: Pennylane positions itself as a comprehensive, AI-enhanced accounting platform.
signals.body: Pennylane is actively marketing its AI-augmented accounting platform, emphasizing its comprehensive features including invoicing, bank reconciliation, expense management, and real-time financial dashboards. The platform is designed for seamless collaboration with accounting firms and is highlighted as being compatible with the upcoming 2026 e-invoicing obligations. Pennylane's strategy appears to be a premium, feature-rich offering.
signals.implication: Pennylane is a strong, well-funded competitor in France, focusing on advanced features and AI. Sage needs to clearly differentiate its value proposition, especially regarding AI and compliance.

signals.title: Contasol's free tier remains a significant player for Spanish SMEs and freelancers
signals.body: Contasol, developed by Software DELSOL, continues to be a widely installed accounting software in Spain, particularly for SMEs and freelancers. Its key advantage is a completely free base version that includes general accounting, automatic entries, treasury management, and fiscal model generation. This free offering makes it a strong contender, especially for the autónomo segment.
signals.implication: The continued strength of Contasol's free offering presents a challenge for Sage Active's penetration into the Spanish autónomo segment. Sage needs to clearly articulate the value proposition of its paid offerings to differentiate from free alternatives.

signals.title: Pennylane Solidifies Market Position in France, Targeting Accountants
signals.body: Pennylane continues to strengthen its presence in the French market, positioning itself as a leading cloud accounting platform for SMEs and accounting firms. With a focus on real-time collaboration between businesses and accountants, Pennylane is well-aligned with the upcoming electronic invoicing mandate. The company offers a dedicated plan for accounting firms and is actively promoting its platform as a modern alternative to traditional software like Sage and Cegid.
signals.implication: Increased competitive pressure from Pennylane in France, particularly within the expert-comptable channel. Sage needs to highlight its own collaborative features and compliance readiness for the PA mandate.

signals.title: France PA Mandate: DGFiP Confirms Sept 1, 2026 Deadline, Pilot Underway
signals.body: The DGFiP has reaffirmed the September 1, 2026 deadline for the French PA mandate, with a pilot program currently in progress. Over 600,000 entities have registered their reception points in the central directory, out of more than 10 million VAT-liable entities. 107 platforms are now accredited, with 61 participating in the pilot. The DGFiP has also sent emails to nearly 6 million entities who have not yet designated a platform, emphasizing the operational risk of delaying this process.
signals.implication: Urgency to ensure Sage Active and other relevant products are fully compliant and ready for the French PA mandate. Proactive engagement with customers to guide them through platform selection and integration is crucial.

signals.title: Pennylane Enhances ComptAssistant AI for Accountants
signals.body: Pennylane's ComptAssistant AI is being integrated more deeply, acting as an AI assistant for accountants. It can analyze client data, provide insights on taxation, regulations, financial health, and assist with platform usage. Data remains within Europe and is ISO 27001 and SOC 2 certified.
signals.implication: Advancements in Pennylane's AI capabilities, particularly ComptAssistant, offer accountants enhanced productivity and advisory services, potentially drawing them away from Sage's offerings if Sage's AI solutions are not as advanced or integrated.

signals.title: Germany's XRechnung e-invoicing mandate for B2B transactions set for 2028.
signals.body: While XRechnung has been mandatory for B2G transactions since November 2020, Germany is implementing phased e-invoicing mandates for B2B transactions. Businesses must be able to receive e-invoices from 2025, with mandatory sending for some businesses starting in 2027 and all others following in 2028. XRechnung is a purely XML-based, machine-readable format compliant with EN 16931.
signals.implication: The upcoming XRechnung mandate for B2B transactions by January 2028 presents a significant compliance challenge and opportunity. Sage for Accountants (SfA) and Sage Active must ensure their solutions are fully compliant and can seamlessly generate and process XRechnung invoices to avoid penalties and capture market share from competitors not prepared for this mandate.

signals.title: Contasol offers a free accounting software version in Spain
signals.body: Contasol, developed by Software DELSOL, is highlighted as one of the most installed accounting programs in Spain, particularly for SMEs and self-employed individuals. Its base version is completely free and includes features for general accounting, automatic entries, treasury management, and fiscal model generation.
signals.implication: The availability of a robust free accounting solution like Contasol could pose a challenge for Sage's entry-level offerings in the Spanish autónomo segment, potentially making it harder to acquire customers who are price-sensitive.
signals.source: Mejor programa de contabilidad: conoce los más usados en España - Rankia - May 25 2026

signals.title: Spain's Verifactu mandate for companies and self-employed shifted to 2027
signals.body: The mandatory implementation of Verifactu, Spain's electronic invoice verification system, has been postponed. For companies subject to Corporate Tax, the deadline is now January 1, 2027, and for self-employed individuals and other professionals, it is July 1, 2027. This provides a grace period for businesses and software providers to adapt.
signals.implication: This shift in deadlines may reduce immediate pressure on Sage Active's Verifactu compliance efforts in Spain, but it also extends the competitive window for rivals who may already be compliant or are rapidly approaching it.
signals.source: Verifactu se retrasa a 2027: lo que necesitas saber (y por qué Properly ya es tu aliado) - March 26 2026

signals.title: Cegid Primavera Continues Strong Market Presence and Product Development in Portugal
signals.body: Cegid Primavera, a leader in the Portuguese market for over 40 years, is actively developing its solutions, with legal updates for HR modules in 2026 and ongoing training sessions for its software. Cegid also recently acquired PHC Software, further consolidating its position in the Portuguese SME market.
signals.implication: Cegid's continued investment and market consolidation, particularly with the PHC acquisition, intensifies competition for Sage in Portugal. Sage needs to highlight its unique value proposition and accelerate its own product roadmap to counter Cegid's established presence and aggressive growth strategy.

signals.title: Cegid strengthens French market presence with EBP acquisition and sales expansion.
signals.body: Cegid's acquisition of EBP, a French software provider, is a strategic move to bolster its offerings for small and medium-sized businesses in France. Cegid plans to add 100 new sales representatives in France in Q2 2026, targeting accounting practices. Cegid's acquisition of EBP is expected to create a European leader serving approximately 750,000 clients.
signals.implication: Cegid's aggressive expansion in France, particularly targeting accounting practices with new sales reps, poses a direct competitive threat to Sage's expert-comptable channel. Sage must counter this by highlighting its own value proposition and partner support.
signals.source: Cegid, EBP, La profession comptable, April 23, 2024

signals.title: France's e-invoicing mandate deadline approaching; 101 accredited platforms available.
signals.body: As of September 1, 2026, all VAT-subject companies in France must be able to receive electronic invoices via an accredited platform (PA, formerly PDP) registered by the DGFiP. As of early Q1 2026, over 100 platforms are officially accredited, with prices ranging from free to nearly €100. Even companies exempt from VAT must use a PA for receiving invoices from suppliers starting September 1, 2026.
signals.implication: Sage needs to ensure its solutions (Sage Active, AutoEntry+AKAO) are either accredited PAs or integrate seamlessly with accredited PAs to meet the September 1, 2026 deadline for all VAT-subject businesses. Competition from the 100+ accredited platforms needs to be monitored.

signals.title: OCC continues to be central to accountant channel in Portugal
signals.body: The Ordem dos Contabilistas Certificados (OCC) plays an essential role in the supervision, training, and ethics of accounting professionals in Portugal, ensuring the reliability of financial information. The OCC also conducts admission exams for certified accountants, highlighting its gatekeeper function for the profession.
signals.implication: Maintaining strong relationships and understanding the evolving needs of the OCC and its certified accountants is crucial for Sage's channel strategy in Portugal.

signals.title: Cegid Primavera consolidates market leadership in Portugal
signals.body: Cegid Group reported a turnover of €85 million in Portugal in 2025, the year it acquired PHC Software. With operations now fully integrated, Cegid expects a further 10% growth in 2026. Primavera BSS (Cegid) is highlighted as a historical leader in the Portuguese market with over 40 years of experience, strong AT certification, and a robust support community.
signals.implication: Cegid's strong and growing presence, bolstered by the PHC acquisition and its established Primavera brand, intensifies competition in the Portuguese market, requiring Sage to differentiate its offerings effectively.

signals.title: Germany's B2B e-invoicing mandate to extend to all businesses by January 2028.
signals.body: Following a proposed timeline, Germany will mandate e-invoicing for all B2B transactions by January 2028. This follows an initial requirement for companies to be able to process inbound e-invoices by January 2025 and for large companies to send electronic invoices by January 2027. After January 2028, only EN 16931 compliant invoices will be accepted.
signals.implication: This regulatory deadline is a critical driver for adoption of e-invoicing solutions in Germany. Sage must ensure its products are fully compliant with XRechnung and EN 16931 standards to support German customers and remain competitive.

signals.title: DATEV initiates major cloud transformation in 2026, phasing out on-premises solutions.
signals.body: DATEV is undergoing its largest portfolio transformation, migrating all core applications to the cloud by 2026, including MyDATEV Kanzlei and DATEV Kanzleimanagement. On-premises solutions will be phased out, with DATEV Rechnungswesen moving to the cloud in H2 2026. This transition is expected to take 24-36 months and presents both risks and opportunities for tax firms.
signals.implication: Sage needs to monitor DATEV's cloud strategy closely, as this significant shift may create opportunities for cloud-native solutions or partnerships, and could impact the competitive landscape for accounting software in Germany.

signals.title: DATEV begins major cloud transformation in 2026
signals.body: DATEV is undergoing its largest portfolio transformation, migrating all core on-premises applications to the cloud starting in 2026, with completion expected over 24-36 months. This includes DATEV Rechnungswesen in the Cloud (H2 2026) and other key management and accounting tools. The move aims to enhance efficiency and support digitalization for tax advisors and their clients.
signals.implication: DATEV's cloud migration could lead to a more integrated and modern offering for German tax advisors, potentially increasing their reliance on DATEV's ecosystem and posing a challenge for Sage's partnerships with these advisors.

signals.title: Germany's XRechnung mandate expands to B2B transactions by 2028
signals.body: Germany is progressively implementing a mandatory structured e-invoicing regime for domestic B2B transactions, with full adoption by January 2028. Businesses must be able to receive EN 16931-compliant invoices from January 2025, issue them if their turnover exceeds €800,000 from January 2027, and all businesses must comply by January 2028. XRechnung is the official German standard for these e-invoices.
signals.implication: Sage Active and Sage for Accountants need to ensure full XRechnung compliance and readiness for all German SMBs and accountants by the 2028 deadline. This includes robust invoicing and receiving capabilities.
signals.source: Vertex AI Search (April 24, 2026; May 08, 2026; May 15, 2025; December 10, 2025; February 25, 2026)

signals.title: Pennylane to host ComptaTech 2026, targeting accounting professionals.
signals.body: Pennylane is hosting ComptaTech 2026 on June 16, 2026, at the Zénith de Paris. This event is specifically designed for accounting firm partners, employees, and creators, focusing on cabinet strategy, new technologies, and business development. This positions Pennylane as a key player engaging directly with the expert-comptable channel.
signals.implication: Sage must counter Pennylane's direct engagement with the expert-comptable channel by reinforcing its own partnerships and demonstrating superior value for French accounting firms.

signals.title: France's PA mandate readiness: 1 million companies registered, 146 platforms identified.
signals.body: As of May 5, 2026, over 1 million companies in France have registered an address in the central directory for the upcoming electronic invoicing mandate. 146 platforms have been identified, with 127 already registered. This indicates significant progress towards the September 1, 2026 deadline, though widespread adoption is still in progress.
signals.implication: Sage needs to ensure its solutions are fully integrated and promoted to meet the September 1, 2026 deadline, highlighting ease of compliance for accountants and their clients.

signals.title: Cegid's acquisition of PHC Software strengthens its market position in Portugal.
signals.body: Cegid, a European leader in cloud business management solutions, acquired PHC Software, a Portuguese company with a strong reputation in the Portuguese market. PHC Software has over 260 employees and reported a turnover of €17.6 million in 2023, with solutions used by 170,000 users across approximately 37,000 client companies. This acquisition, along with Cegid's previous acquisition of Primavera, positions Cegid as a dominant player in the Portuguese SME market.
signals.implication: Increased competitive pressure from a consolidated Cegid in Portugal, particularly in the SME segment. Sage needs to monitor Cegid's integration strategy and product roadmap for the Portuguese market.
signals.source: Clearwater, Iberian Lawyer, Business Wire, ECO SAPO, Reddit, Teamlyzer, 2025-2026

signals.title: Cegid and EBP Consolidate French Market Presence
signals.body: Cegid's acquisition of EBP, finalized in April 2026, creates a significant player in the French SMB software market. With a combined user base of 750,000 clients and a strong focus on TPE/PME, this merger positions Cegid-EBP to aggressively target the French market, leveraging EBP's established presence and Cegid's broader European reach. They are also integrating their PA solutions for free with Cegid and EBP software.
signals.implication: This consolidation presents a formidable competitor in France. Sage WiSE needs to differentiate its offerings, particularly for the expert-comptable channel, by highlighting unique value propositions and potentially accelerating its own market entry or feature development in France.

signals.title: France Issues Compliance Push for Sept 2026 E-invoicing Mandate
signals.body: The DGFiP (French tax authority) has begun emailing businesses that have not yet selected a platform for the upcoming e-invoicing mandate, effective September 1, 2026. Companies are urged to choose a platform via their accountant, management software, or directly through an accredited platform to avoid issues receiving future invoices. This compliance push highlights the urgency for businesses to prepare.
signals.implication: Sage needs to accelerate its efforts to ensure Sage Active and other relevant products are fully compliant and marketed as solutions for the French PA mandate, emphasizing ease of integration and support for accountants.

signals.title: OCC to Host 8th Congress of Certified Accountants in Lisbon
signals.body: The Ordem dos Contabilistas Certificados (OCC), Portugal's professional body for certified accountants, will host its 8th Congress in Lisbon from September 22-24, 2026. This event brings together a significant portion of the country's approximately 70,000 certified accountants.
signals.implication: The OCC Congress is a key event for engaging with the accountant channel in Portugal. Sage should consider participation or targeted outreach during this period to understand accountant priorities and promote Sage for Accountants.
signals.source: Ordem dos Contabilistas Certificados (Nov 09 2021), Ordem dos Contabilistas Certificados (Mar 11 2026)

signals.title: Germany clarifies phased e-invoicing mandate, full B2B sending by 2028
signals.body: Germany's phased approach to e-invoicing mandates that all businesses must be able to receive e-invoices by January 1, 2025. The mandatory sending of e-invoices will be phased in, with large businesses (over €800,000 turnover) required to comply from January 2027, and all other businesses by January 2028. Accepted formats include XRechnung and ZUGFeRD.
signals.implication: Confirms the critical deadline for XRechnung compliance in Germany. Sage must ensure its products fully support these mandates to avoid penalties and maintain market relevance.
signals.source: Trustpair, February 27, 2026; E-Invoicing in Germany, May 19, 2026
